_comment: Build Log — living per-project documentation. Edit as each project is built; the panel (panels/build_log.html) re-renders from this file. Schema per project: id, name, week, status(done|in_progress|planned|slipped), headline, metrics[{label,value}], entries[{date,title,status,detail,refs[{label,kind(commit|file|run|link),href}]}], decisions[{title,detail}]. Newest entries first.

projects.name: Music Genre — BEARDOWN
projects.headline: Model 1 reproduced and frozen at CV 0.714 (clean log-mel, batch-matched). FORGE Bayesian layer (LLLA + HMC) is the next build.

entries.title: ML usage / cost estimator built
entries.detail: _shared/usage.py turns every compute.json into energy / carbon / $ with measured-vs-modeled tags, an actual-power hook (RAPL / nvidia-smi), a suite roll-up, and a pre-run projection. Assumptions live in an override YAML for real rates IRL.

entries.title: Song drop-in inference verified (wav + mp3)
entries.detail: End-to-end: drop audio → 30-s windows → clean mel + 57 features → per-genre scores with MC-dropout σ. load_audio hardened (soundfile → librosa fallback → clear error, no silent skip). Works because train + inference now share one mel recipe (validate r=1.0).

entries.title: Backbone frozen: clean-128 / batch-8, CV 0.714
entries.detail: Batch 32→8 lifted CV 0.629→0.714 (+0.086). The frozen deterministic backbone the Bayesian head attaches to. 6× cheaper to train than the original 224 dirty pipeline and the only variant that does real-audio drop-in correctly.

entries.title: Gap diagnosis complete — every cheap hypothesis ruled out
entries.detail: Early stopping, epochs, representation, split, and resolution all tested and eliminated as the cause of the 0.07 gap to 0.766. Lever was batch size; residual is framework (Keras vs PyTorch) + run variance. Faithful, documented reproduction.

entries.title: Clean log-mel regeneration (silent-failure fix)
entries.detail: Kaggle grey PNGs are colormapped matplotlib figures — luminance non-monotonic in mel energy, so a dropped song scored noise. Regenerated all spectrograms from audio with one recipe → train + inference share extract_mel → validate passes by construction.

entries.title: Architecture vetted against the public INFO_510 repo
entries.detail: Confirmed cfg_14: 57 features (length dropped), gated fusion, deterministic head, dense 512/192, lr 7.37e-5, adam, 75 epochs. The winning head was already det — so the FORGE det-backbone + LLLA reproduction is bit-faithful with zero mechanism mismatch.

entries.title: Bayesian layer — LLLA + HMC on the frozen head
entries.detail: Last-layer Laplace (closed form from cached GGN) for the live τ-knob path, HMC as gold-standard check, then the observatory panel with live knobs and an LLLA-vs-HMC overlay. The frozen 0.714 point estimate becomes a decomposable posterior — the FORGE core.

decisions.title: Batch size was the lever (+0.086 CV)
decisions.detail: 32→8 lifted CV 0.629→0.714. Smaller batch = gradient-noise regularization on small data. Batch 8 is also the BatchNorm floor for this net and matches cfg_14.

decisions.title: 224 resolution ruled out
decisions.detail: Dirty-224 scored CV 0.629 — erased the batch-8 gain at 6× the compute and 3× the memory. Resolution is not the lever.

decisions.title: Clean log-mel over dirty Kaggle grey
decisions.detail: Clean mels score ≥ dirty AND are the only representation reproducible at inference from a dropped wav. A deliberate, documented improvement over the original pipeline.

decisions.title: Split is not the gap
decisions.detail: BEARDOWN's seed-42 stratified split scored ≈ our track split (0.673 vs 0.70) — ruling out an unlucky-draw explanation for the gap.

decisions.title: Freeze, don't chase 0.766
decisions.detail: The wall at ~0.71 is precisely FORGE's motivating example: accuracy-only selection stalls and says nothing about trust. The Bayesian layer is the answer, not more tuning.
